claims.text: Deep learning methods operate as black boxes.
The uncertainty associated with deep learning predictions is often challenging to quantify.
Bayesian statistics offer a formalism to understand the uncertainty associated with deep neural network predictions.
Bayesian statistics offer a formalism to quantify the uncertainty associated with deep neural network predictions.
